criteria.expectation: Shared job subscription registry tracks and exposes connecting, connected, reconnecting, and failed states across consumers; ignores retired generations; preserves public backendSubscribeJobs compatibility
criteria.verification: Unit and integration tests in shared-job-subscriptions.test.tsx
evidence: shared-job-subscriptions.test.tsx: verifies failed before connect, initial connected, late-joining consumer receiving current state, reconnecting on TIMED_OUT/CHANNEL_ERROR after prior connection, reconnected: true on subsequent SUBSCRIBED, and status-listener error isolation.

criteria.expectation: Active job polling uses fast baseline cadence before SUBSCRIBED or when degraded/offline, and shifts to slower safety reconciliation cadence once SUBSCRIBED and online
criteria.verification: Adaptive interval unit tests and useJobPoll fake-timer integration tests
evidence: adaptive-poll.test.ts and job-poll-recovery.test.tsx: verifies 1s/8s/15s/45s/60s before SUBSCRIBED and 10s/30s/45s/120s/180s once SUBSCRIBED, plus immediate fallback when degraded or offline.

criteria.expectation: Consecutive read failures apply bounded exponential backoff with optional jitter without overlapping in-flight reads, and reset to base cadence after recovery
criteria.verification: Backoff/jitter unit tests in adaptive-poll.test.ts and failure-recovery tests in job-poll-recovery.test.tsx
evidence: adaptive-poll.test.ts: verifies exponential backoff ceilings and symmetric jitter bounds. job-poll-recovery.test.tsx: verifies 15s -> 30s -> 60s failure backoff on en_route and reset to 15s base after a successful read.

criteria.expectation: Subscription readiness (post-initial-fetch SUBSCRIBED), reconnects, browser online events, and tab visibility transitions trigger coordinated reconciliation reads without duplicate bursts
evidence: job-poll-recovery.test.tsx: verifies reconnect reconciliation, mid-initial-fetch SUBSCRIBED readiness follow-up, and online/offline transitions. cloud-job-subscription-lifecycle.test.tsx: verifies cloud-store reconnect and online reconciliation.

criteria.expectation: Visual countdowns remain driven by authoritative server deadlines locally while healthy pairing/negotiation network polling slows down, and terminal jobs avoid rapid polling
evidence: CountdownTimer and useExactCountdown remain unchanged and driven by server pairingDeadline / negotiateEndsAt; cancelled/expired terminal statuses slow to 180s when realtime is healthy.

criteria.expectation: Hidden-tab pause, Phase 2A/2B single-flight and scope guards, pro incoming-card rules, and protected files remain intact; lint, typecheck, test suite, and build checks pass
criteria.verification: Repository gates (npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run test) and diff audit
evidence: 175 test files / 1,717 tests passed; npm run typecheck passed; npm run lint passed with 0 errors; git diff --check passed; no protected files modified.
